title: Assistant Professor in Computer Science
application_fee: Rs. 500/- for General candidates; PwD candidates are exempted.
summary: Centre of Professional Courses, Aligarh Muslim University invites online applications for one temporary Assistant Professor post in Computer Science for the academic session 2026-2027. The consolidated monthly salary is Rs. 30,000/- and applicants must submit their online applications by 29 Nov 2026 followed by hardcopies by 07 Dec 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Assistant Professor (Computer Science): A Master's degree with 55% marks in a relevant subject along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. degree in accordance with UGC regulations.

vacancy_breakdown.eligibility: Master's degree with 55% marks and NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D.

how_to_apply_steps: Visit the Careers Portal of the University at https://careers.amuonline.ac.in.
Fill out the online application form and pay the non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 500/- online.
Take a printout of the submitted PDF application form on A-4 size paper, sign it, paste a photograph, and attach self-attested copies of all required certificates and documents.
Super-scribe the post applied for, advertisement number, and date on the top-left side of the cover.
Submit the complete application by post to the Office of the Centre of Professional Courses, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002 on or before 07.12.2026.
